description: Estimate what stored files cost per month and per year from a size, the price bands the caller's storage plan sends, and growth. Send the size in the unit the prices use (for example GB with a price per GB per month), the price bands (one flat price, or bands such as first 50, next 450, then the rest), how the bands apply (graduated or volume), optional growth per month (a fixed amount or a percent), the number of months (1 to 120) and an optional minimum monthly charge. Get back the cost for every month, the first month, the yearly cost at the first month's rate, the total for each year of the period, the total for the whole period, the size at the end, and which months the minimum charge applied. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/storage-cost-estimate). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

growth_per_month.description: Size added each month, in the same unit (default 0). Send this or growth_percent_per_month, not both.

growth_percent_per_month.description: Size growth each month in percent of the size the month before (compounding; 5 for 5%). Default 0.

label.description: Optional label, for example 'archive drive' (your own text, echoed; not a person).

minimum_monthly_charge.description: Smallest charge for any month, in your currency (default 0).

months.description: How many months to estimate, 1 to 120 (default 12).

size.description: Size stored now, in the unit your prices use (for example 2500 for 2,500 GB).

size_basis.description: start_of_month (default): month 1 is billed on the size you send, month 2 after one month of growth. end_of_month: month 1 is billed on the size after one month of growth.

tier_mode.description: graduated (default): each band's price applies only to the part of the size inside that band. volume: the whole size is priced at the band it falls in.

tiers.description: Price bands, lowest first. One band with no up_to is a flat price. Every band but the last needs up_to, rising; the last has no up_to.

price.description: Price per unit of size per month in this band (up to 6 decimals), in your currency.

up_to.description: Top of this band in the same unit as size (included in this band). Leave out on the last band only.

unit.description: Unit of size and of every price. Echoed back only; no unit is converted (send size and prices in the same unit).

name: storage_cost_estimate
title: Storage Cost Estimate (Monthly and Yearly)
